title: atuna penangiana
intro: Atuna penangiana, commonly known as the Penang ironwood or Penang mahogany, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapindaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Atuna penangiana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimalarial, and antiseptic properties.
